run_motor_max_velocity_simulation: run the pybullet cartpole simulation that demonstrates joint motor max velocity control in GUI mode
run_set_joint_motor_control: run the pybullet setJointMotorControl2 API to control a joint with position control and a max velocity limit
run_get_joint_state: run the pybullet getJointState API to read a joint's current position and velocity during simulation
run_load_urdf: run the pybullet loadURDF API to load a cartpole URDF model into the physics simulation
run_set_gravity: run the pybullet setGravity API to configure gravity forces in the physics simulation environment
